name: Source Data specific licence unresolved; article CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 recorded separately
data_specific_license_status: No separate licence found in the Source Data workbook or article data-availability statement; general publisher data-sharing policies do not specify a blanket Source Data licence. This is an unresolved scope finding, not a prohibition.
repository_scope: The article-linked Panorama experiment explicitly states Data License: CC BY 4.0. Inspected registered Skyline runs are the standard/isomer library and three-glycan ovalbumin discovery document. No matching export of the Source Data panels was verified, so this licence is not assigned to the XLS matrices.
glycopost_scope: GlycoPOST states no use or redistribution restrictions on deposited data; its website CC0 notice excludes user-submitted data. This does not establish the terms of the Springer-hosted XLS workbook.
GPST000602_general_policy_finding: The same policies do not establish blanket data-specific terms for DOI 10.1038/s41467-026-70850-0 supplementary quantitative tables.
